src/components/FuelMap.tsx:    const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * (Math.PI / 180);

src/components/FuelMap.tsx:      Math.sin(dLat/2) * Math.sin(dLat/2) +
src/components/FuelMap.tsx:      Math.cos(lat1 * (Math.PI / 180)) * Math.cos(lat2 * (Math.PI / 180)) * 
src/components/FuelMap.tsx:      Math.sin(dLon/2) * Math.sin(dLon/2);

src/lib/utils.ts:export function cleanObject<T>(obj: T): T {

src/lib/utils.ts:
src/lib/utils.ts:  // Handle arrays
src/lib/utils.ts:  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {

src/lib/utils.ts:  }

src/lib/utils.ts:  // Only recurse into plain objects. 
src/lib/utils.ts:  // Firestore sentinels (FieldValue) and other special objects should be left as is.

src/lib/utils.ts: */
src/lib/utils.ts:export async function compressImage(base64Str: string, maxWidth = 800, quality = 0.6): Promise<string> {

src/lib/utils.ts:    img.src = base64Str;

src/lib/utils.ts:      let width = img.width;
src/lib/utils.ts:      let height = img.height;
src/lib/utils.ts:
src/lib/utils.ts:      if (width > maxWidth) {
src/lib/utils.ts:        height = (maxWidth / width) * height;
src/lib/utils.ts:        width = maxWidth;
src/lib/utils.ts:      }
src/lib/utils.ts:
src/lib/utils.ts:      canvas.width = width;
src/lib/utils.ts:      canvas.height = height;
src/lib/utils.ts:
src/lib/utils.ts:      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
src/lib/utils.ts:      if (!ctx) {

src/lib/utils.ts:        return;
src/lib/utils.ts:      }
src/lib/utils.ts:
src/lib/utils.ts:      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
src/lib/utils.ts:      const compressed = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
src/lib/utils.ts:      resolve(compressed);
src/lib/utils.ts:    };
src/lib/utils.ts:    img.onerror = () => resolve(base64Str);
